source_control.push: Fast-forward push succeeded; the branch advanced from the recorded previous head.

behaviors: The action registry enforces a distinct reviewed icon and plain-language Hungarian label/description for each action.
The left navigation and right Inspector toggles update icon, accessible label and explanation to match the actual open/closed state.
Desktop hover and keyboard focus expose a persistent, dismissible explanation; Escape closes it and pointer movement onto the explanation preserves it without intercepting other controls.
Coarse-pointer touch reveals a visible contextual explanation; the selected mobile panel supplies a task-specific description.
Save remains a draft-only operation, separate from the visibly labelled Publish action. Help/panel interactions do not write the page model.
